name: Kitchel Family Organics
description: Kitchel Family Organics is a working farm in Fort Bidwell, CA. It grows Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, Peppers, and Eggplant, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Nov in this growing zone.
